name: Re:amaze
description: Re:amaze is a unified customer service platform for ecommerce and online businesses, combining a shared inbox, live chat, chatbots, and an AI agent trained on the business's own content.
best_for: Ecommerce and online businesses on Shopify, BigCommerce, and WordPress wanting agent productivity tools alongside AI-assisted support.
features: Shared inbox unifying email, live chat, social, SMS, VoIP, and video calls
AI Agent (beta) trained on the business's own help center content
Cues for proactive, trigger-based customer engagement
Peek real-time co-browsing to observe customer behavior
Push campaigns for re-engagement and sales
Embeddable FAQ/help center that also trains the AI agent
